scope: saved metadata closure only; not P1, not source generation
selection: protocol slot order only; no outcome, cost, difficulty or success ranking
sampling: inherit exact protocol recipe SeedSequence([root_seed,0,0]); no new sampling in this chat
failures: retain duplicate, guard, degenerate, partial, not_started and all unsuccessful slots in denominator 4
exclude: root and reset seed cross-namespace matches, including reserved half-open spans
conditional historical closed spans checked conservatively but never called certified
root-goal, state7, wrapped pose, snapshot or RGB3 identity matches
XY tolerance 1e-9 pixel and wrapped-angle tolerance 1e-12 rad; no velocity/goal/renderer escape
batch-internal duplicates; raw history alone is not physical identity
missing source identity or historical scope/bound evidence blocks admission
seed0_exception: explicit-state placement reset only; not a new random root and not proof all seed0 states coincide
approval: external MAIN coverage scope/SHA required; no self-approval
freshness: requires actual future state/pose/snapshot/history exclusion before witness dispatch; new directory or seed is insufficient
cutoff: exact sealed 618-path inventory snapshot, not all history through current wall time; subsequent MAIN activity requires explicit delta inventory
